title: Authorization change: role check moved into a shared helper
context: Refactor moving permission checks into one helper. No behaviour intended to change.

security_sensitivity.basis: every authorisation decision now flows through one helper

business_criticality.basis: controls access to all customer data

dependency_complexity.basis: 22 modules now depend on the new helper

coverage_deficit.basis: tests cover the helper but not every migrated call site

reasoning_notes: A no-behaviour-change refactor of authorisation is exactly where silent privilege escalation appears. Existing tests passing is not sufficient evidence.
A 403 is genuinely ambiguous between a product defect and missing test credentials, so classifier confidence must stay capped.
